history.text: Sarah plans to retire in 2034 and describes her risk preference as moderate. Portfolio snapshot: $920,000 total, 75% equities, 20% fixed income, 5% cash. Prefers email updates at this time.
Sarah has begun helping her elderly mother with living expenses. She raised concerns about future healthcare costs and asked to revisit her retirement budget.

Sarah moved her retirement target from 2034 to 2031. She explicitly changed her risk preference to conservative and requested less portfolio volatility. No allocation changes were agreed during this meeting.

Recorded portfolio value is $1,080,000, allocated 58% equities, 34% fixed income, and 8% cash. The allocation change follows the prior discussions about reducing volatility. Snapshot differences are not investment-return calculations.

Sarah asked to review the beneficiaries on her retirement accounts. The advisor promised to send the current beneficiary list by September 1, 2026. This record does not confirm that any beneficiary was changed.

Sarah now prefers quarterly phone calls rather than email-only check-ins, with a short written recap. She requested an updated retirement budget that includes healthcare costs. The advisor agreed to prepare it by October 15, 2026.
The beneficiary-list follow-up remains open; no delivery confirmation is recorded. The healthcare retirement-budget update also remains pending. Sarah has not yet met the incoming advisor.
